description: This file contains unit tests for the ScriptedIncomingMapping class, specifically testing the JavaScript integration for mapping external messages to internal protocol representations using Rhino JavaScript engine. It includes tests for mapping messages, creating protocol messages, and executing JavaScript scripts within a sandboxed context.

classes.name: ScriptedIncomingMappingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ScriptedIncomingMapping Java class, focusing on JavaScript-based message mapping functionality within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: mapExternalMessage
methods.description: Tests the mapping of an external message to a native JavaScript object and verifies the byte payload.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageFromReadOnlyBuffer
methods.description: Tests the mapping of an external message from a read-only ByteBuffer.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageTextAndBytes
methods.description: Verifies the extraction of text and byte payloads from an external message mapped to a NativeObject.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageProducingArrayOfDittoProtocolMessages
methods.description: Tests the execution of a JavaScript function creating Ditto protocol messages and verifies the resultant adaptables.

methods.name: testJavascript
methods.description: Sets up a Rhino JavaScript sandbox, loads required scripts, executes a provided script, and applies assertions to the resulting adapted message list.
